_key.description: Variant key, phenotype ontology term and source file accession joined by underscores.

effect_size.description: Estimated phenotype effect size (mu or mu_adj)

z_score.description: Z-score of the variant's effect size, as the posterior mean over its uncertainty. Files that calibrate against the negative-control variants report the adjusted z-score (mu_z_adj) instead of the raw one.

significant.description: Whether the 95% confidence interval for effect size excludes 0.

num_guides.description: Number of guides aggregated for the variant in the screen.

edit_rate_mean.description: Mean effective prime-editing rate across the variant's guides: the fraction of cells edited, from 0 to 1. Reported only by reporter-readout files.

effect_size_ci95_lower.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for effect size.

effect_size_ci95_upper.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for effect size.

crispr_modality.description: The CRISPR modality from the associated files_filesets record

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the file this measurement was read from.

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.
biological_context.example: human HCT116 cell line from donor(s) IGVFDO0384OZRW

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples for the purpose of perturbation, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when none were applied.

accessible_via.return: name, class, label, method, crispr_modality, source, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term, effect_size, z_score, significant, num_guides, edit_rate_mean, effect_size_ci95_lower, effect_size_ci95_upper
